shuffle_scope.description: Which techs to include: key (~53 essential), standard (~205 gameplay), full (all 502)

shuffle_boss_tech.description: Include boss-gated technologies in the shuffle

tier_progression.description: open=all tiers accessible, keyed=tier keys required, strict=sequential tiers

difficulty.description: Logic difficulty — affects item progression classification

tech_visibility.description: locked=techs visible but unpurchasable, hidden=techs invisible until unlocked

tech_completion_pct.description: Percentage of shuffled techs required (for tech_completion goal)

goals.name: all_bosses
